jobs.title: Project Manager - Remote
jobs.location: Quezon City, National Capital Region, Philippines
jobs.description:
Project Manager - Job Description

The US spends $160 Billion per year on highways. Every new car model costs at least $1 Billion to develop. Yet cars spend only 5% of their time driving. Where do these cars spend the other 95%? PARKED!

LAZ Parking is one of the largest operators in the growing multi-billion-dollar US parking industry. Founded in 1981, LAZ operates hundreds of thousands of parking spaces from offices nationwide. When it comes to parking, we are the experts!

Most importantly, LAZ is a PEOPLE FIRST company with a mission to "create opportunities for our employees and value for our clients." If you're looking to join a growing company led by passionate people committed to being the best, contact us today!

The Spirit of the Position

The Project Management Office (PMO) supports projects across every department at LAZ, including Operations, Finance, Technology, HR, Client Services, and newly acquired or partner businesses. The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams, coordinates internal and external partners, and keeps projects moving toward organizational goals.

The PMO works as both a project lead and a consulting partner. Depending on the project, this role may run a project end to end or help a department plan and run their own work using PMO tools and resources. The right person for this role will be able to adapt to the needs of the business or project in an agile way, always identifying and executing to add value and support.

Principal Duties

Planning and delivery

Build short- and long-term project plans with clear milestones, owners, and deadlines
Track progress against the plan and keep timelines and quality on track
Adjust schedules, scope, and targets as business needs, priorities, or funding change
Coordinate go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing (UAT), data validation, training, pilot rollouts, and handoff to operational owners
Close out projects by confirming ownership transfer, documenting lessons learned, and capturing project outcomes

Team and partner leadership

Lead cross-departmental teams, making roles, responsibilities, and goals clear for everyone involved
Assign and track action items with owners across departments, vendors, and partners
Serve as the main point of contact when multiple teams or departments share a project so everyone stays aligned
Manage vendor and partner relationships through implementation, including kickoffs, recurring status calls, contract and timeline coordination, and follow-up on open items
Support the integration of acquired or partner businesses onto LAZ systems and processes
Lay out options and tradeoffs so sponsors and stakeholders can make timely decisions

Communication and reporting

Facilitate recurring project meetings and send timely recaps with decisions, action items, owners, and due dates
Keep stakeholders updated so the project stays aligned with their goals
Build and maintain Monday.com boards and dashboards, project reports, and all project communications
Contribute to portfolio-level reporting, including the monthly PMO Executive Summary

PMO intake and continuous improvement

Support the PMO intake and discovery process by helping requesters through intake, connecting them with the right teams, and helping build business cases
Contribute to PMO resources such as playbooks, SOPs, templates, SharePoint content, newsletters, and feedback surveys
Help departments plan and run their own projects using PMO tools and best practices

Education

Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience
PMP or CAPM certification preferred

Experience

5+ years of project management experience, ideally in a PMO or multi-department setting
Experience leading software or system implementations with outside vendors
Experience with business integrations, operational transitions, or process changes across multiple departments is a plus

Skills

Works independently and makes timely calls on day-to-day project matters
Leads cross-functional teams without direct authority, including resolving conflicts and negotiating effectively
Manages vendor and partner relationships, keeping outside teams accountable to timelines and deliverables
Prioritizes tasks, manages time, and handles multiple projects across different departments at once
Works comfortably with people at every level of the organization, from frontline teams to executives
Strong written communication, including clear meeting recaps, status updates, and executive summaries
Brings a sense of urgency and follow-through
Adapts quickly to changing project requirements and priorities
Supports change management and business readiness so new tools and processes actually get adopted
Familiar with project management and collaboration tools such as Monday.com, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Loop), Jira, Trello, Asana, or GitHub
Comfortable working through system integrations and implementations with IT, development teams, and vendors, and willing to learn technical concepts as needed
Translates between technical and non-technical stakeholders so everyone has a shared understanding of project requirements

FLSA Status:
Exempt

In all our employment practices, including hiring, we are committed to equal opportunity without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, or any other basis of discrimination prohibited by applicable local, state, or federal law. No question in our application process is used for limiting or excluding any applicant's consideration for employment on such grounds.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Feasibility Site Activation
jobs.description:
Project Manager FSA - EUROPE - Homebased

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

About The Role

At ICON plc, we are committed to improving and saving lives through clinical research. As a Project Manager – Feasibility & Site Activation
, you will play a critical role in driving the successful start-up of global clinical studies.

This is a highly visible position where you will take ownership of the Study Start-Up (SSU) strategy and execution—ensuring that sites are activated efficiently, regulatory pathways are navigated effectively, and studies are positioned for successful delivery from day one.

You will work at the center of cross-functional collaboration, partnering with sponsors, internal teams, and sites worldwide to deliver start-up excellence at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

Shape and execute Study Start-Up strategies across global, multi-country studies, ensuring alignment with timelines, scope, and sponsor expectations
Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive Study Start-Up Plans, covering regulatory, ethics, and contract execution across all participating countries
Drive end-to-end start-up activities from site identification through to IP release, maintaining momentum and accountability for key milestones
Provide strategic input at Bid Defence and Kick-Off meetings, influencing study design and start-up feasibility from the outset
Oversee regulatory and ethics submissions, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely approvals across regions
Manage site contract and budget negotiations in collaboration with legal, finance, and sponsors, supporting timely site activation
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, implementing mitigation and escalation strategies to protect study timelines
Partner closely with Project Managers and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring seamless integration of start-up within overall study delivery
Ensure accuracy, quality, and inspection readiness of all study documentation, including oversight of CTMS and eTMF activities
Lead and coordinate Study Start-Up team members, providing direction, support, and oversight to ensure consistent delivery
Drive process consistency and continuous improvement across regions, contributing to operational excellence initiatives
Maintain oversight of study metrics, budgets, and scope of work (SOW), ensuring delivery within agreed parameters
Provide clear, structured reporting and updates to sponsors and internal leadership, enabling informed decision-making

Your Profile

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related field.
Recent Study Start-Up (SSU) experience with end-to-end site activation responsibility.
Experience supporting global and multi-country clinical trials.
Strong knowledge of CA/EC submissions, CTA processes, and regulatory requirements.
Experience managing site contracts, budgets, and start-up timelines.
Working knowledge of CTMS, eTMF, and other clinical systems.
Solid understanding of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
Organized, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

At The Apricity Group, we help organizations unlock growth and create lasting impact through innovative strategies, partnerships, and solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, curiosity, and execution — driving results while staying true to our values of integrity, adaptability, and excellence.
We’re expanding our Rocketlane PSA Implementation Practice and are looking for a Project Manager to help drive results!
Role Overview
As a Project Manager, you will own the successful delivery of Rocketlane PSA implementations from kickoff through go-live and adoption. You will lead customers and delivery teams through complex onboarding journeys driving clarity, accountability, and momentum at every stage.
This is not a status-reporting role.
You are the quarterback of the engagement: aligning stakeholders, managing risks, guiding decisions, and ensuring customers realize value fast. You’ll balance consultative leadership with operational rigor, keeping projects on track while advising customers on best practices and course-correcting when needed.
This role blends customer-facing consulting, delivery leadership, and business ownership. You’ll work closely with Solution Architects, Consultants, and Integration specialists to deliver scalable, repeatable outcomes across multiple clients.
Key Responsibilities
Own the full project lifecycle from kickoff through go-live and transition
Lead discovery, planning, and alignment sessions with customer stakeholders
Establish clear scope, outcomes, and success criteria
Translate business objectives into actionable delivery plans
Drive cross-functional delivery across Solution Architects, Consultants, Integrations, and Data teams
Run governance cadences, status reviews, and executive updates
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and trade-offs resolving them quickly
Manage scope changes and protect delivery integrity
Guide customers toward Rocketlane and Professional Services best practices (not just take requests)
Lead tough conversations and escalations with confidence and clarity
Track budgets, forecasts, utilization, and project margin
Ensure adoption readiness through training, change management, and transition planning
Use AI tools, automations, and standardized assets to streamline project operations
Conduct retrospectives and continuously improve delivery playbooks

Success Metrics
On-time, on-budget project delivery
Project margin attainment
Customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
Time-to-value and successful go-live outcomes
Scope stability and change control effectiveness
Low escalations and smooth stakeholder alignment
Team utilization and forecast accuracy
Delivery process improvements and reusable practices created

Qualifications
Must Have Skills

Professional English proficiency is a must.

Delivery Leadership

3+ years leading SaaS or PSA implementations
Proven ability to run multiple customer engagements simultaneously
Experience owning projects end-to-end with minimal supervision
Strong understanding of onboarding and implementation best practices

Consulting & Stakeholder Management

Comfortable leading workshops and executive conversations
Ability to be assertive and guide customers toward the right approach
Experience navigating escalations and difficult trade-offs
Excellent written and verbal communication
Strong facilitation and decision-making skills

Operational & Business Acumen

Experience managing scope, budgets, and financial performance
Resource planning and forecasting experience
Risk management mindset
Data-driven approach to delivery performance

Ownership & Problem Solving

Bias for action and accountability
Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments
Proactively removes blockers rather than escalating them
Strong organizational discipline and follow-through

Bonus Skills

Experience with PSA tools (Rocketlane, Certinia, Kantata, etc.)
Professional Services or consulting delivery background
Familiarity with CRM/ERP ecosystems
Change management or adoption experience
PMP, CSM, or equivalent mindset
Experience using AI/automation to improve operational efficiency

Training & Certification Path (Required)
Rocketlane Academy Training Path – 1 week
TAG Rocketlane Implementation Methodology Review – 2 days
Klient PSA Training – 2 days
Klient PSA Time Tracking – 1 day
Admin Teach Back – 1 week

Career Path
Associate PM → Project Manager → Senior PM
You’ll Thrive Here If You
Love owning outcomes, not just managing tasks
Naturally step into leadership in ambiguous situations
Enjoy running customer conversations and building trust quickly
Stay calm under pressure and solve problems proactively
Like balancing people, process, and business results
Want to help shape a modern, AI-first Professional Services practice

Competitive base salary.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

The Senior Power Delivery Project Manager provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, and monitoring of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation initiatives, within a defined geographic region, utility client base, or technical discipline. Supports utility capital programs and Power Delivery portfolios by ensuring all responsibilities across the full project lifecycle—including proposal development, project planning and startup, engineering coordination, procurement, construction execution, schedule and cost control, reporting, and project closeout—are executed, documented, and audited in accordance with WSP project management standards, Power Delivery best practices, and client requirements. Provides practical leadership, process improvement, and innovative solutions to address schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management challenges within a dynamic, regulated, and evolving Power Delivery and energy infrastructure environment

This position will be based out of Richmond, VA with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location in the region. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide Power Delivery project management leadership for large‑scale and complex utility infrastructure projects, ensuring clear task ownership, schedule accountability, and delivery milestones across transmission, distribution, and substation scopes; prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, margins, KPIs, earned value, hours and expenses, monitor external risks and contingencies, and ensure contractual compliance and successful delivery of assigned Power Delivery project portfolios.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies for utility clients, internal leadership, engineering teams, contractors, and regulators, maintaining strong relationships and providing timely reporting on project status, risks, and performance. [
Provide guidance during pursuit, initiation, and project startup phases, supporting Go/No‑Go decisions, contract and commercial reviews, pricing strategies, delivery risk assessments, and mitigation planning for Power Delivery and utility capital projects
Participate in and support the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, client presentations, scope alignment discussions, and project execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.
Mentor and coach project managers, engineers, and support staff, supporting career development, performance improvement, and leadership growth within the Power Delivery organization.
Manage, evaluate, and provide performance leadership to assigned staff, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety expectations, and delivery standards
Ensure timely updates and governance compliance for project management systems and documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans
Facilitate and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to establish roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Coordinate with area managers, technical leads, and resource managers to address staffing, subcontracting, and specialty support needs in a timely manner across Power Delivery programs.
Maintain regular client communications, including monthly progress reporting, safety performance, major risks/issues, and scope or budget impacts, reinforcing WSP’s role as a trusted Power Delivery advisor.
Participate in and lead problem project and recovery reviews, conducting root‑cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and developing project recovery and mitigation plans
Ensure consistent project reporting and governance updates to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, proactively identifying emerging scope, schedule, cost, or risk issues.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, cash flow, and invoicing, coordinating with project accounting and finance teams to resolve issues and maintain financial health of Power Delivery projects.
Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [
Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards
Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, client commitments, project risks, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
12+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.
Highly proficient understanding of the project delivery lifecycle within the A/E/C and utility industries, including proposal development, project initiation, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, commissioning, and project closeout, with a strong background in Power Delivery project management
Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.
Advanced proficiency in critical thinking, risk‑based decision‑making, and problem‑solving, including performing project management assessments, schedule and cost evaluations, forecasting, and scenario analysis to optimize Power Delivery project outcomes.
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively, persuasively, and professionally with executive leadership, utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.
Demonstrated self‑leadership and accountability, with strong attention to detail, quality, multitasking, and adaptability in a fast‑paced Power Delivery and utility project environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while providing technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to mid‑level and senior project staff, with strict adherence to QA/QC, safety, and delivery standards.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

The Senior Power Delivery Project Manager provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, and monitoring of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation initiatives, within a defined geographic region, utility client base, or technical discipline. Supports utility capital programs and Power Delivery portfolios by ensuring all responsibilities across the full project lifecycle—including proposal development, project planning and startup, engineering coordination, procurement, construction execution, schedule and cost control, reporting, and project closeout—are executed, documented, and audited in accordance with WSP project management standards, Power Delivery best practices, and client requirements. Provides practical leadership, process improvement, and innovative solutions to address schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management challenges within a dynamic, regulated, and evolving Power Delivery and energy infrastructure environment

This position will be based out of Richmond, VA with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location in the region. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide Power Delivery project management leadership for large‑scale and complex utility infrastructure projects, ensuring clear task ownership, schedule accountability, and delivery milestones across transmission, distribution, and substation scopes; prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, margins, KPIs, earned value, hours and expenses, monitor external risks and contingencies, and ensure contractual compliance and successful delivery of assigned Power Delivery project portfolios.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies for utility clients, internal leadership, engineering teams, contractors, and regulators, maintaining strong relationships and providing timely reporting on project status, risks, and performance. [
Provide guidance during pursuit, initiation, and project startup phases, supporting Go/No‑Go decisions, contract and commercial reviews, pricing strategies, delivery risk assessments, and mitigation planning for Power Delivery and utility capital projects
Participate in and support the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, client presentations, scope alignment discussions, and project execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.
Mentor and coach project managers, engineers, and support staff, supporting career development, performance improvement, and leadership growth within the Power Delivery organization.
Manage, evaluate, and provide performance leadership to assigned staff, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety expectations, and delivery standards

Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [
Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards
Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, client commitments, project risks, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
12+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.

Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.

Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively, persuasively, and professionally with executive leadership, utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.

Demonstrated ability to influence and gain cooperation from a broad range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, utility clients, subcontractors, consultants, and matrixed internal teams, without formal authority.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Life Sciences Program Executive

Brazil or Argentina | Remote

Job Description

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.

The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce.

Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact

AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.
Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.
Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. You earn trust through consistently accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.
The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.
The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.
Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.
Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.
White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce.

Minimum Requirements

Demonstrated experience applying AI productivity tools, automation, or agentic workflows within a professional services or program delivery context, with measurable impact on delivery efficiency or customer outcomes
12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes
Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes
5+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) sufficient to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities
5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, earned value analysis, and delivered-versus-bid margin
End-to-end knowledge of system development, implementation, and operational readiness within Life Sciences environments, including familiarity with regulated industry requirements
Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and outcomes
Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical, commercial, and regulatory audiences
Must be able to operate as a fully billable IC

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level, with the ability to credibly advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
Deep knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field engagement, HCP engagement, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls, and data-driven customer insights
Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or equivalent CRM platforms purpose-built for pharma and biotech
PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale
Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud); certifications are a requirement of the role and available through the global education reimbursement program
Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline
Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context, including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Additional Information

Travel approximately 25%, with variation based on customer need
Bachelor's degree required

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Responsible for managing all aspects of large-scale strategic, broad-based projects within the Compensation COE, such as focal merit transition in Workday, pay range design, and budget planning. Leads and implements high-priority initiatives that support alignment with compensation goals and strategic planning. Develops the project schedules, budget, and various program and project plan details. Builds and analyzes data reports, providing deep analytical insights. Identifies and escalates issues and risks and recommends solutions.

Essential Functions

Provides lead support and guidance for various redesign initiatives and programs, such as job description changes management, focal point transition, and other initiatives to support the compensation strategy.

Title And Summary

Lead Technical Program Manager

Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

The Digital Solutions Engineering team is responsible for Mastercard’s electronic payment system as well as ensures payments are convenient and secure. The products are primarily focused on authentication, tokenization, fraud prevention, and risk mitigation across all payment channels as well as all stakeholders, issuers, acquirers, merchants, processors, and consumers. The key objectives of the solutions are to prove identity, reduce abandonments, reduce fraud, increase approval rates, and secure the payments ecosystem.

We are hiring a Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Authentication Solutions platform. The core Authentication Solutions (3DS and Passkey based) teams use a mix of technologies as we work to revolutionize our technology offerings.

Job Overview

Technical Program Managers at Mastercard collaborate to define the how and when of our strategic delivery goals. This role plays a pivotal role in driving complex, cross-functional projects and maintain alignment of our goals to organizational objectives. The responsibility of this teammate is to ensure technical solutions are delivered on time and meet the desired outcomes.

This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in decision-making, problem decomposition, and effective communication, while maintaining a strong grasp of business context and technical details.

Accelerate project progress by making crisp, timely decisions and clearing blockers.
Navigate difficult situations to find viable paths forward and decompose problems into manageable units from ideation to execution.
Organize work for optimal delivery, negotiating priorities, facilitating progress, and raising issues to management as needed.
Maintain TPM artifacts, track SDLC milestones, and manage dependency target dates actively.
Secure shared understanding and buy-in for solutions, clearly describing their impact on Mastercard and its customers.
Use communication as a preventive control, ensuring meetings are effective, consensus is built, and decisions are well-documented.
Optimize approaches, demonstrate improvements using data, and drive continuous improvements through retrospectives, staff meetings, and status updates.
Proficiently manage scrum delivery, understand business context, customer use cases, and the functionality, architecture, and dependencies of involved systems.
Represent team services to stakeholders and external partners, bringing developers or SMEs to meetings as necessary.
Actively manage dependencies, influence vendors and partners, and ensure alignment with program goals.
Deliver independently while occasionally seeking direction from peers and managers.

All About You

Born simplifier.
Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong ability to make timely decisions and manage complex projects.
Proficiency in scrum delivery and a track record of optimizing processes and demonstrating improvements with data.
Deep understanding of business context, customer use cases, system functionality, and industry technologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead effective meetings, build consensus, and clearly articulate decisions.
Experience in managing dependencies, influencing external partners, and representing team services to stakeholders.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to serve as the technical subject-matter expert (SME) for the Trust and Assurance team. This role will be responsible for leading the technical side of the compliance automation function of the team. A core part of the role is analyzing controls within the GRC platform to ensure they are accurate, meet framework requirements, and pull the necessary evidence to prove effectiveness. You will also partner with engineering teams to embed compliance into their workflows from the start. Strong compliance framework knowledge, solid program-management skills, and experience with AI technology are essential.

What You Will Do

Serve as the team's technical authority.

Act as the technical SME and primary point of contact for the Trust and Assurance team: interpret how systems and controls work, guide technical decisions, and identify opportunities to make workflows and tooling more efficient.

Manage compliance stack.

Oversee control mapping, evidence collection, and monitoring workflows, and manage the integrations that connect the GRC platform to cloud platforms and internal systems.

Establish control monitoring. Translate technical controls into automated, continuous checks, expanding monitoring coverage across the compliance stack and replacing manual reviews with ongoing monitoring.
Reduce audit burden.

Ensure every control has an accountable owner, support gap assessments and the rollout of new frameworks, and keep controls in a continuously audit-ready state.

Embed compliance into engineering.

Partner with engineering teams to build compliance requirements into their workflows and processes from the start, so compliance is designed in rather than added later.

Drive delivery and keep stakeholders aligned.

Manage initiatives through to completion, and communicate compliance risk, control status, and program progress to technical and non-technical audiences through clear, actionable summaries.

What You Will Bring

4+ years in GRC, compliance, or a technical role supporting cybersecurity programs, including leading programs and guiding or mentoring others.
Strong program and project management skills, with a track record of delivering across multiple teams.
Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and/or FedRAMP) and hands-on audit experience.
Enough technical depth to be the team's technical point of contact: comfortable reasoning about cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, and data flows, and interpreting technical work with AI assistance, even if you do not write code.
Proven ability to lead technical discussions with engineers and subject-matter experts and ask the right questions to understand how controls and systems work.
Hands-on experience with a GRC or compliance-automation platform (e.g., LogicGate, ServiceNow, Drata), and comfort using AI tools in compliance workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between compliance and engineering for both technical and leadership audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills:

Ability to write code or scripts (e.g., Python) to build automation directly.
Experience building AI/ML-powered or agentic applications, and with API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, or deploying production-grade services.
Technical background in systems administration, software engineering, cloud security, or security engineering.
Prior experience as a technical SME, or as a bridge between compliance and engineering teams.
Experience leading a SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or NIST 800-53 audit end-to-end, and familiarity with OSCAL or other compliance-automation tooling.
Familiarity with security monitoring tools (e.g., Tenable, Splunk), Git, and cloud infrastructure automation tooling (e.g., Terraform, Puppet, Jenkins).
Experience in SaaS, GovCloud, FinTech, or other highly regulated environments.
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CCSK, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

In addition to base salary, we offer additional compensation including bonus eligibility and a comprehensive benefits package.  A candidate’s specific pay within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including job- related skills, training, location, experience, relevant education, certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Job Title: Material Program Management (MPM) Manager (Remote)

Job Code:
43756

Job Location:
Remote Opportunity

Job Schedule
: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

The Material Program Management (MPM) Manager is the Supply Chain focal point responsible for leading the end-to-end material strategy and execution for assigned programs. This role partners closely with Program Management, Procurement, Planning, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance/Business Management, and other Supply Chain functions to ensure material requirements are aligned to program cost, schedule, production, and customer commitments.

The MPM Manager leads a team of Material Program Managers and is accountable for providing clear visibility to the program’s overall material position, including material availability, procurement status, shortages, supplier risks, forecast performance, inventory, and production readiness. The manager ensures risks are identified early, actions have clear ownership and closure plans, and material issues are escalated at the appropriate level before they impact program execution.

This position requires a leader who can operate strategically while maintaining strong discipline, translate complex material information into actionable program-level insights, and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution of material, cost, schedule, and supplier challenges.

Essential Functions:

Lead, develop, coach, and provide day-to-day direction to a team of Material Program Managers supporting assigned programs.
Own and drive the integrated material strategy for assigned programs, ensuring procurement, planning, inventory, supplier performance, quality, engineering, and production activities are aligned to program requirements and schedule.
Lead material readiness and Line of Balance (LOB) reviews to determine whether material supports planned production and delivery schedules. Identify constraints, gaps, and material at risk of not meeting program need dates.
Drive proactive identification and management of material risks and opportunities, ensuring each significant issue has a clearly defined program impact, root cause, mitigation/recovery plan, action owner, and required completion date.
Establish appropriate escalation paths for critical material and supplier issues and ensure risks are elevated based on potential impact to production, customer commitments, cost, and schedule.
Lead the material forecasting process for assigned programs, including development and validation of monthly and quarterly material forecasts, identification of major forecast drivers, risks and opportunities, and corrective actions necessary to improve forecast accuracy.
Analyze forecast performance and material actuals to identify significant variances, understand root causes, and implement corrective actions that improve predictability and financial performance.
Partner with Procurement and Supplier Management organizations to ensure critical supplier issues are actively managed and recovery plans support program requirements.
Support development and execution of program proposals, Estimates at Completion (EACs), material budgets, long-range material strategies, and other program financial planning activities.
Provide clear, concise executive-level communication regarding material status, significant risks and opportunities, forecast performance, supplier challenges, recovery actions, and decisions or support required from leadership.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 9 years of prior related management experience; or a Graduate Degree or equivalent with 7 years of prior related management experience; or a minimum of 13 years of prior related management experience in lieu of a degree.

Preferred Additional Skills:

Experience within aerospace, defense, or another complex engineered product/manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting development and/or production programs from early development through qualification, production ramp, and full-rate production.
Working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems, material requirements planning, production planning, procurement, inventory management, supplier management, and manufacturing operations.
Experience with material forecasting, EACs, program financial management, risk and opportunity management, and integrated program schedules.
Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, develop recovery strategies, and lead cross-functional teams through complex material and supplier issues.
Experience implementing process improvements, standard work, reporting automation, dashboards, or data-driven management tools.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar analytics and visualization tools is preferred.
Knowledge of government contracting and the defense acquisition environment, including applicable FAR/DFARS requirements, is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, operate effectively in a matrixed organization, manage competing priorities, and make timely decisions in a rapidly changing environment.
Strong leadership, coaching, communication, problem-solving, and executive presentation skills.
Ability and willingness to travel to company facilities, customers, and suppliers as business needs require.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

About The Department

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager
Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence
Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies
Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation
Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Flexible Spending Accounts

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (Planning – Payments Domain)
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Technical Program Manager (Planning – Payments Domain)

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Mastercard Network & Digital Payment Services team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own planning and delivery execution across our product and platform portfolio. You will run the planning function for the organization — roadmap, forecast, budget, headcount, and delivery commitments — across multiple concurrent programs.

As Senior Technical Program Manager, you will work with product managers, tech leads, architects, and operations and engineering leaders to deliver complex programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, build execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, manage escalations, and balance business needs against delivery constraints.

This is a planning and execution role rather than a hands-on engineering one. Success depends on structure, judgment, and problem-solving: bringing clarity to ambiguous work, making the plan and its trade-offs visible, and keeping leadership and delivery teams aligned on the same picture of reality.

The ideal candidate brings an entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to build the mechanism that doesn't exist yet, and able to run several unrelated programs at once without dropping any of them. You will spend much of your time with senior leaders and partner teams you do not manage, so the ability to influence without authority and earn trust quickly is essential. Highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and a strong problem-solve

Role

Lead Program Delivery: Drive complex technical programs end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams, removing blockers, and delivering against committed outcomes.
Own Planning & Roadmaps: Translate strategy into prioritized roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, and forecasts across multiple teams and initiatives.
Manage Budget & Resources: Partner with Finance and Engineering to manage budgets, headcount, capacity, vendor spend, and trade-offs across competing priorities.
Drive Program Health: Establish program metrics, manage risks and dependencies, track delivery performance, and provide clear executive-level reporting and recommendations.
Influence Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Finance to drive alignment and accountability without direct authority.
Solve Complex Problems: Bring structure to ambiguity, identify root causes, resolve delivery challenges, and proactively drive decisions and issues to closure.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Use data, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to improve program execution, delivery predictability, operational processes, and alignment with strategic objectives.

All About You

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Proven program leadership: Lead large-scale technical programs from inception through delivery, translating vision into measurable business outcomes.
Strategic planning & execution: Build road maps, manage priorities, and execute complex programs across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid environments.
Financial & resource management: Own program budgets, forecasts, headcount, capacity planning, and resource allocation across multiple teams.
Executive communication: Clearly communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to senior executives using concise, data-driven insights.
Cross-functional leadership: Influence without authority, align senior stakeholders and partner teams, and drive accountability across complex organizations.
Technical & analytical acumen: Apply strong problem-solving skills and technical fluency to assess complexity, identify delivery risks, and drive effective decisions.

Desirable / Additional Capabilities

Thrives in ambiguity: Creates structure, processes, and solutions where requirements or established practices are unclear.
Entrepreneurial mindset: Identifies opportunities, takes ownership, and drives improvements beyond defined responsibilities.
Global program coordination: Experience managing stakeholders, teams, and vendors across multiple locations and time zones.
Technology delivery expertise: Familiarity with software development lifecycles, release management, testing, and operational readiness.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

About Highwood

Highwood Emissions Management is the industry's independent partner on methane — combining the world's most widely deployed methane reporting platform with a consulting team that sits at the frontier of measurement science, regulatory development, and emissions strategy.

Our clients include producers accounting for over 10% of global oil and gas production. We have delivered more than 300 methane engagements across 50+ operators on six continents, and we maintain a 100% success rate on OGMP 2.0 Gold Standard submissions. When regulations change, we know first — because our team is writing the standards, advising regulators, and shaping industry practice from the inside.

We launched in 2020 with a mission to collaborate, innovate, and educate our way to a world with effective and affordable emissions management. That mission is more urgent than ever: methane is shifting from voluntary disclosure to commercial liability, and the operators who get this right early will have a durable competitive advantage. Our job is to make sure they do.

Working at Highwood is not easy — but it is meaningful, fast-moving, and genuinely consequential. If you want to work on one of the hardest and most important problems in energy transition, alongside people who are shaping how the world measures and manages methane, this is the place.

Highwood is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. We value diversity of experience, worldview, and perspective.
Your Mission 

The Senior Marketing Program Manager owns the planning, execution, and evolution of Highwood's core marketing programs across customer marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), corporate communications and public relations, and partner and community programs. You will turn Highwood's technical leadership into credible proof points, stronger market visibility, deeper customer engagement, and measurable pipeline impact. 
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone that is looking to partner with a team that is passionate about building high-performing programs and is looking to work alongside industry experts looking to make eliminating methane achievable and provable. Highwood is looking for a driven marketing and communications lead who can build program frameworks, cross-functional operating systems, scalable processes, and lead execution to ensure programs launch, perform, and improve over time. 
Core Responsibilities 

Corporate Communications & Public Relations 

·       Own and execute Highwood's corporate communications and PR strategy, with a strong focus on media relations. 
·       Develop regulatory and market-update media programs that strengthen Highwood's position as a thought leader in emissions management. 
·       Draft and distribute press releases, media materials, and internal communications that reinforce brand positioning and support business priorities. 
·       Build and maintain relationships with key media contacts, analysts, and industry influencers, and support proactive reputation and crisis communications. 
ABM Program Management & Execution 

·       Define and operationalize Highwood's ABM program frameworks, including 1:Many campaigns. 
·       Design and execute regional ABM campaigns that reflect local market dynamics, customer needs, and Sales priorities. 
·       Establish campaign calendars, stakeholder cadences, success metrics, and reporting that connect engagement to pipeline influence and ROI. 
·       Use performance data to iterate programs and improve results across target accounts and geographies. 
Customer Marketing & Advocacy 

·       Develop and execute customer communications for major initiatives and product updates. 
·       Create customer-facing materials that support inside and outside Sales. 
·       Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success so customer insights inform marketing strategy and program development. 
·       Build and scale a structured customer advocacy program, including case studies, customer reference, and referral programs that turn customer success into credible proof points for Sales and Marketing. 
·       Establish a clear customer engagement framework and systematically capture and share customer feedback across the business. 
Partner & Community Programs 

·       Expand partnership opportunities and reach across strategic and community partners. 
·       Develop and manage co-marketing campaigns, joint events, and partner enablement materials. 
·       Integrate partner and community programs into the broader marketing calendar and measure their contribution to brand and pipeline goals. 
What Success Looks Like 

·       Highwood's presence in target media and industry publications increases, with coverage that is proactive, on-message, and aligned to business priorities. 
·       ABM programs are structured, measurable, aligned with Sales, and demonstrate engagement and pipeline contribution across priority accounts and regions. 
·       Customer advocacy becomes a repeatable program: customer achievements are consistently captured, reference programs are accessible to Sales, and customers stay engaged through ongoing communications and programs. 
·       Partner and community programs are clearly defined, consistently executed, and tied to measurable brand and pipeline outcomes. 
·       Cross-functional programs run with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, reporting, and continuous improvement. 
About You 

·       Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent practical experience. 
·       7-10+ years of experience in B2B marketing program or project management, with experience in emissions management within oil and gas, with experience in environmental technology preferred. 
·       Proven track record leading complex, multi-channel marketing programs from concept through execution, measurement, and iteration. 
·       Demonstrated experience in at least three of the following: customer advocacy, ABM/ABX, corporate communications/PR, customer marketing, or partner/channel marketing. 
·       Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to align Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and external partners. 
·       Experience building and managing program roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics. 
·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting press releases, media materials, and executive communications. 
·       Working knowledge of HubSpot, project management tools, and marketing analytics platforms. 

The Benefits
