jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

About The Department

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager
Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence
Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies
Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation
Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. You will keep the control set mapped once so a single test produces evidence for every framework, maintain the GRC tool as the system of record, own Groq's IT policies and security training, and take on audit execution to mature the GRC function from reactive to proactive program.

Run the audit calendar across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and other frameworks; manage day-to-day auditor relationships, fieldwork logistics and evidence readiness.
Track audit findings through to closure with owners and dates so findings do not recur between cycles.
Maintain the control catalogue and framework mapping so one control test produces evidence for every framework it satisfies, and coordinate SME evidence requests so each control is evidenced once per period, not once per framework.
Maintain Vanta GRC as the system of record: integration coverage, automated evidence, test ownership and documentation within their review cycle.
Own the IT policy lifecycle (review cadence, approvals, acknowledgements) and the security awareness training program, with completion tracked as audit evidence; report audit status, open findings and evidence coverage to security leadership on a recurring basis.

5+ years in compliance program management, including hands-on execution of at least two concurrent framework audits.
Experience mapping controls across frameworks and reducing duplicate evidence collection, and administering a GRC platform as a system of record.
Experience managing external auditors, drafting scope statements for executive review, and coordinating SMEs across stakeholders.
Experience owning a policy lifecycle and a security awareness training program, with completion evidence that has stood up in audit.
Experience at a Big 4 or equivalent audit firm delivering compliance engagements, so you know how auditors scope, sample and write findings.

Purposeful Hiring: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build with matters.

jobs.description:
Mission

Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. You will keep the control set mapped once so a single test produces evidence for every framework, maintain the GRC tool as the system of record, own Groq's IT policies and security training, and take on audit execution to mature the GRC function from reactive to proactive program.

Location:
This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area
. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

Responsibilities & Opportunities In This Role

Run the audit calendar across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and other frameworks; manage day-to-day auditor relationships, fieldwork logistics and evidence readiness.
Track audit findings through to closure with owners and dates so findings do not recur between cycles.
Maintain the control catalogue and framework mapping so one control test produces evidence for every framework it satisfies, and coordinate SME evidence requests so each control is evidenced once per period, not once per framework.
Maintain Vanta GRC as the system of record: integration coverage, automated evidence, test ownership and documentation within their review cycle.
Own the IT policy lifecycle (review cadence, approvals, acknowledgements) and the security awareness training program, with completion tracked as audit evidence; report audit status, open findings and evidence coverage to security leadership on a recurring basis.

Ideal Candidates Have/are

5+ years in compliance program management, including hands-on execution of at least two concurrent framework audits.
Experience mapping controls across frameworks and reducing duplicate evidence collection, and administering a GRC platform as a system of record.
Experience managing external auditors, drafting scope statements for executive review, and coordinating SMEs across stakeholders.
Experience owning a policy lifecycle and a security awareness training program, with completion evidence that has stood up in audit.
Experience at a Big 4 or equivalent audit firm delivering compliance engagements, so you know how auditors scope, sample and write findings.

Why Join Us

Purposeful Hiring: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build with matters.
Builders Wanted: You’re not just riding the rocket ship, you’re building it. Your work directly shapes the trajectory of our company.
Mission-Driven Work: We’re here to make a real impact. Our mission fuels everything we do.
Tackling Hard Problems: If easy isn’t your thing, you’re in the right place. We solve some of the most complex and exciting challenges in our space.
Excellence Is The Standard: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious.

Compensation

Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary range for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is $186,600 - $252,400, with individual placement determined by your geographic location, experience, skills, and alignment with internal compensation standards. This range is specific to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for international candidates will vary based on local market dynamics. Beyond cash compensation, Groq also offers a Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program and a robust suite of employee benefits.

Manage project financials, review and approve invoices, track budget variance, job cost, and productivity, and report on financial performance.
Successfully negotiate change orders.
Act as key point of contact with customers and end-user owners. Manage and develop customer and subcontractor relationships. Source and qualify new opportunities.
Develop and manage a high-performance team. Provide mentorship and training to employees to ensure growth and development.

About You

You possess dynamic leadership and management skills to influence and drive positive outcomes. You have thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking, and reporting methods necessary to profitably complete electrical construction projects. You have experience with union workforces, labor rate calculations, and collective bargaining agreements. In addition to your technical knowledge, you have a history of successfully leading teams and are passionate about developing and growing employees to their full potential.

Thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking, and reporting principles necessary to profitably complete electrical construction projects.
Experience with union workforces, labor rate calculations, and collective bargaining agreements preferred.
Verifiable experience of safe, reliable and integrity-driven work habits, including working in unsupervised field settings, and remote office locations when appropriate.
Strong management and leadership skills, to include a history of leading teams with a passion for developing employees.
Strong ability to influence and drive positive outcomes.
Highly proficient in MS Word, Excel, and Project. Experience with Accubid Classic preferred.

What You Will Gain

Upon joining the team at Cupertino Electric, you’ll be exposed to a new, diverse community of client, vendor and subcontractor partners. You will be empowered to build new relationships to enhance your future business development opportunities. As a Project Manager, you have an important responsibility of managing CEI’s projects in line with goals, financial parameters, and within the project timeline and specification with the purpose of optimizing revenue growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Armed with CEI’s top notch tools and copious internal resources, with the expertise you bring and a little elbow grease, you’re sure to be successful.

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages.

jobs.title: Market & Business Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Market & Business Intelligence Manager, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, will lead the development and execution of analytics strategies that support firm-wide decision-making, portfolio optimization, and sector intelligence. This role will manage a team of business analysts, ensuring high-quality delivery of data products and insights that power various intelligence initiatives. This role will also itself have responsibilities to gather, analyze and provide insights that inform firm strategy, talent strategy, and business development. The ideal candidate combines technical depth, strategic thinking, ability to communicate clearly with senior executives and staff, and strong leadership capabilities.

Location

This position can sit in our Reston, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Raleigh, San Diego, Seattle, Short Hills, Washington DC, or Wilmington office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Development: Manage and mentor a team of analysts, fostering a collaborative, high‑performance culture.
Strategic Planning and Execution: Design and implement analytics strategies that align with firm goals, including proactive intelligence delivery and client segmentation.
Project Management: Lead analytics projects from scope to delivery, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations are met.
Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with senior leaders across Sector Practices, Practice Groups, Business Development & Marketing, and corporate groups to understand needs and deliver actionable insights.
Data Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to data governance policies, maintaining data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
Tool Development and Enhancement: Oversee the evolution of internal tools for advanced business analytics, workflow automation, and reporting capabilities.

Desired Skills  

Proven success building and leading analytics teams. Leadership & Team Management: Demonstrated ability to develop talent and lead cross-functional teams. Statistical Analysis & Data Mining: Proficiency in statistical methods and techniques to extract insights from complex datasets, including expertise with AI for market & business analysis. Advanced Analytics: Deep knowledge of analytics methodologies, tools, and technologies, including predictive modeling and segmentation. Programming & Database Management: Strong skills in the Microsoft environment (e.g., Fabric, Azure), Python, R, or SQL, with experience in querying and managing large databases. Data Visualization: Expertise in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to create impactful visualizations. Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving: Ability to approach challenges analytically and recommend data-driven actions. Strategic Thinking: Experience aligning analytics initiatives with business goals and driving measurable impact. Project Management: Skilled in managing multiple projects with competing priorities and stakeholders. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to translate complex data into clear insights and influence decision-making across departments.

Minimum Education   

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.

Preferred Education   

Masters Degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

8 years’ progressive experience working in the business analytics, market research and/or competitive intelligence environment.

Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

Provide all source analytic support to collections, operations, investigations, and other defense intelligence analytic requirements
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policy makers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings

Active DoD Top Secret/SCI

Position Summary

Noetic is seeking a Cyber Intelligence Analyst to support intelligence analysis and cybersecurity missions in Huntsville, Alabama. The analyst will research and evaluate cyber threats, foreign adversary capabilities, and potential vulnerabilities affecting software, technology, and defense systems.

The successful candidate will use intelligence sources, cyber threat data, and analytical tools to identify threat actors, assess tactics and techniques, and develop intelligence reports and briefings. This role requires experience with all-source intelligence analysis, cyber operations, and the ability to communicate findings to technical and operational stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities

A Security Analyst works as an individual contributor within Threat Response organization. This role is responsible for leading complex alert investigations, validating and responding to security incidents, and supporting real-time decision‑making during high‑severity events.

The analyst will gain a strong working knowledge of Edward Jones’ technology environment, security tooling, and operational processes, and applies that knowledge to quickly assess scope, impact, and appropriate response actions. This role may guide junior analysts, contribute to incident response execution, and ensure investigations are thoroughly documented and operationally sound.

What You Will Do

Investigate, validate, and triage security alerts to identify and respond to security incidents, escalating confirmed or high‑risk activity in accordance with Threat Response procedures.
Lead in‑depth analysis of host, network, log, file, and identity data to determine incident scope, root cause, and potential impact.
Coordinate with incident response partners and technical teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery actions during active security incidents.
Provide real‑time analytical input to Threat Response leadership during high‑severity or time‑sensitive incidents to support rapid decision‑making.
Ensure all investigations, actions, and outcomes are accurately documented in case management systems to meet operational, audit, and legal requirements.
Mentor and support junior Threat Response analysts by reviewing investigations, providing guidance on analysis techniques, and reinforcing consistent investigation standards.
Maintain a strong understanding of the Edward Jones environment, common attack patterns, and adversary techniques relevant to Threat Response operations.
Contribute to continuous Threat Response improvement by identifying gaps in alerting, investigation workflows, and response procedures based on incident experience.
Participate in incident after‑action reviews and exercises, providing operational insights and recommended improvements to Threat Response processes.
Maintain proficiency in SOC tooling, including SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, LogRhythm) and case management/orchestration tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Swimlane, XSOAR).

What Experience You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in information systems or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience
Minimum of 3 years Information Systems Security experience, or 5 years of Information Technology experience with a focus on security controls and processes
Experience performing routine host, vulnerability, network, file, and log analysis from a variety of sources and platforms to support the incident response, threat detection, and hunt lifecycles.
Experience properly document/track all security investigations and work to meet department, audit, and legal requirements.
Maintain knowledge and understanding of current security threats and vulnerabilities and of how threat actors execute common attack paths. Ensure timely and accurate collection of this threat intelligence data for analysis and reporting purposes.
Contribute to the team's processes and documentation by suggesting opportunities to incorporate industry best practices and lessons learned from previous events.
Participate in after-action reviews for security incidents and red team exercises.
Effectively communicate with peers and leadership to ensure awareness of progress and challenges.

The Ethics & Compliance Data Analyst supports the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the company's Ethics & Compliance (E&C) program through data-driven insights, advanced analytics, technology-enabled solutions, and reporting. Key Responsibilities

Program Operations: Support the E&C program lifecycle (risk assessment, policy management, training, communication, investigations, audits, analytics). Partner with Legal and other functions (i.e. HR, Internal Audit, Finance, etc.) and business leaders to embed compliance into operational processes.
Data, Analytics & Insights: Develop and maintain impactful dashboards, analytical products, and technology-enabled solutions using E&C data sources (e.g., hotline/case systems, training platforms, third-party risk, gifts and travel, conflicts of interest, investigations, and audit findings). Monitor key indicators such as allegation volume, cycle time, training completion, audit activity, OARs, and awareness campaigns. Transform complex data into clear visual stories that communicate risk hotspots, trends, root causes, and remediation efforts across geographies, business units, functions, and organizational structures. Establish data quality controls, coordinate data integrations and exports, automate recurring reporting processes, and maintain governance of key E&C data sources.
AI & Technology Enablement: Implement E&C-related AI and automation initiatives that improve data analysis, reporting, and visualization capabilities. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop and deploy AI-enabled tools, workflows, prompts, and templates that support E&C processes. Manage the E&C portfolio of AI use cases from intake and prioritization through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications that enhance data accessibility, reporting capabilities, and decision-making across the E&C function.
Stakeholder Engagement & Culture: Create executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate E&C performance, risks, trends, and key insights to targeted audiences. Track E&C engagement with leadership populations (i.e. DGMs, MDs, etc.), including proactive monitoring for stakeholder rotation. Provide data and trend analysis to support quarterly board-level reporting. Support campaigns that promote ethical culture by using data to target messaging and optimize channels. Train stakeholders on dashboard usage and data interpretation and enable self-service analytics where appropriate.

Integrity & discretion - Handle sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment and professionalism.
Analytical problem solving & innovation - Use data, analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to identify trends, uncover actionable insights, solve challenges, and improve E&C decision-making and program effectiveness.

Operational excellence - Organize workflows, meet deadlines, and document processes.

Tools & Technologies

Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel including Power Query and PivotTables); business intelligence and data visualization platforms; AI and automation tools; workflow technologies; data integration and reporting solutions.

In this role, you will enhance security defenses, respond swiftly to emerging threats, and foster a security‑aware culture that safeguards clients and staff while enabling the agency to operate efficiently and responsibly.

The Department of Health and Wellness offers opportunities to grow and advance in a dynamic sector that touches the lives of all Nova Scotians. To do this, we need leaders at all levels of the organization who embrace a challenge and believe in their ability to make a difference.

The Health System Infrastructure Branch of the Department of Health and Wellness supports the planning, governance and oversight of health care infrastructure projects across Nova Scotia. Working with health system partners, delivery agents and other government departments, the Branch helps ensure infrastructure investments respond to health service needs and support safe, effective and sustainable care for Nova Scotians.

About Our Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Health Project Management and Governance, the Project Manager Governance provides project management leadership and governance oversight for an assigned portfolio of complex, provincially funded health care infrastructure projects.

You will maintain a clear view of project scope, schedule, budget, risk, change, approvals, and key dependencies. You will work closely with Nova Scotia Health, IWK Health, Department of Public Works, Build Nova Scotia and interdepartmental teams to support coordinated decision-making, clarify accountabilities and bring forward issues requiring departmental or government direction.

Provide governance and departmental oversight for a portfolio of complex health care infrastructure projects.
Monitor project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, changes, approvals, milestones and dependencies, and escalate material matters through the appropriate governance structure.
Co-chair project steering committees and participate in other governance forums, working with partners to establish agendas, document decisions and actions, and monitor commitments.
Lead and support implementation and continuous improvement of governance standards, tools and processes, including risk management, change management, stage-gate requirements, reporting and escalation practices.
Prepare executive and Ministerial briefings, decision requests, submissions, reports, presentations and recommendations that support timely, informed decisions.

A bachelor’s degree in engineering and eligibility for registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with Engineers Nova Scotia; or

jobs.description:
Description

Der Betrieb bildet das Herzstück aller Aktivitäten von Amazon. Dank eines effektiven Betriebs werden Artikel verarbeitet und pünktlich an unsere Kunden versandt. Als ICQA-Data Analyst:in spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Erstellung von Berichten auf Basis von Daten. Du lieferst wichtige Erkenntnisse über die Ursachen von Qualitätsmängeln und Bestandsanpassungen.

Key job responsibilities

Messung der Qualität und Genauigkeit von Bestandsvorgängen bei gleichzeitiger Rückmeldung an den Betrieb
Planung und Ermittlung der Ursachen von Bestandsabweichungen durch Ursachen-Wirkungs-Analyse
Entwurf von Abfragen, Zusammenstellung von Daten und Erstellung von Berichten zur Darstellung der Analyse (Diagramme, Grafiken)
Überprüfung und Analyse von Kundendefektdaten zur Entwicklung entsprechender Aktionspläne zur Reduzierung von Defekten
Entwicklung von Datenerfassungsprozessen und Datenmanagementsystemen

A day in the life

Du stellst sicher, dass wichtige Leistungskennzahlen täglich, wöchentlich oder monatlich überprüft werden.

Du führst detaillierte Analysen zu Verhaltensweisen und Prozessen durch, die sich auf die Bestandsintegrität auswirken.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Inbound, Outbound und Bestandskontrolle zusammen, um Tools zu entwickeln und Daten zu analysieren, die Verbesserungsinitiativen unterstützen.

Du untersuchst Daten gründlich, um die Ursachen von Fehlern zu ermitteln, erstellst und pflegst Entscheidungshilfetools und präsentierst die Ergebnisse den Geschäftspartnern, um Verbesserungen in der Qualität des gesamten Fulfillment Centers (FC) voranzutreiben. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du mit Bereichs- und Betriebsleitern zusammen, um Richtlinien gemäß den Standardarbeitsanweisungen zu kommunizieren.

About The Team

Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.

Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.

In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic Qualifications

Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1 Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen, CEFR).
Berufserfahrung im Bereich Datenanalyse, Data Warehouse-Berichterstellung und Abfragedesign.
Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit der MS Office-Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in einem professionellen Umfeld

Preferred Qualifications

Eigeninitiative bei der Entwicklung von Tools, Datenerfassungsprozessen und Datenverwaltungssystemen
Kenntnisse über Amazon-Systeme und Prozesse in Fulfillment-Centern
Kenntnisse von SQL/VBA
Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, die Geschäftsleitung anhand von Erkenntnissen zu beeinflussen
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit agiler Entwicklung

Research companies, industries, buyers, investors, and potential acquisition targets.
Prepare concise company profiles, market summaries, and buyer research for active and potential engagements.
Build and maintain buyer lists, deal trackers, CRM records, and other internal research resources.
Help coordinate diligence by organizing requests, tracking open items, and maintaining clear Q&A and status logs.

Interested in business, finance, entrepreneurship, or how companies operate. Prior M&A experience is not required.
Comfortable with Excel and PowerPoint, or motivated to develop those skills quickly.
Interested in using AI and other tools thoughtfully to improve research and execution.

Focused on working efficiently and building a professional role with a generally predictable, roughly 40-hour workweek. Deal deadlines can occasionally require additional time, but this position is not structured around investment banking hours.

The Program Manager is responsible for leading the integrated delivery of complex programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.

The initial assignment will support a major strategic programme involving artificial intelligence, automation and emerging technologies. The role will establish the programme structure, roadmap, integrated plan and governance arrangements and provide clear oversight of outcomes, dependencies, risks, resources, costs and decisions.

This is a generalist Program Manager position. The successful candidate may subsequently lead other strategic, regulatory, product, data, digital and operational-change programmes as business priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Establish the programme structure, governance model and delivery cadence.
Translate strategic objectives into an integrated programme roadmap and plan.
Define:
programme outcomes and scope;
projects and workstreams;
milestones and delivery gates;
roles and accountabilities;
governance and decision forums;
escalation routes.

Coordinate business, product, technology, operations, risk and other stakeholders.
Manage programme-level:
scope and milestones;
dependencies and critical paths;
resources and capacity;
costs and forecasts;
risks, assumptions, issues and decisions;
actions and governance requirements.

Coordinate opportunity assessment, prioritisation and mobilisation.
Integrate requirements, solution delivery, controls, testing and operational readiness into the programme plan.
Coordinate pilot design, implementation, adoption and value-measurement activities.
Monitor progress against agreed outcomes, milestones and delivery gates.
Identify and resolve cross-project conflicts, dependencies and delivery constraints.
Escalate material risks, resource gaps and unresolved decisions.
Prepare executive updates, governance materials and decision papers.
Facilitate programme, steering and decision-making forums.
Manage scope changes and assess their impact on outcomes, schedule, cost, resources and risk.
Maintain clear records of programme decisions, approvals, actions and delivery evidence.
Coordinate implementation, hand-offs and transition into sustainable ownership.
Support benefit tracking, post-implementation reviews and lessons learned.
Use approved digital and AI-enabled tools to improve programme planning, analysis and reporting while retaining appropriate human accountability.

Scope and Accountability

Leads a complex programme comprising multiple projects or interconnected workstreams.
Defines and maintains the programme-management approach, integrated plan and governance structure.
Operates with a high degree of autonomy within agreed strategic objectives.
Coordinates stakeholders across business, product, technology, operations and control functions.
Accountable for consolidated programme visibility, including outcomes, progress, dependencies, risks, resources and decisions.
Develops options and recommendations where material delivery trade-offs exist.
Ensures programme-level risks, dependencies and decisions are identified, owned and escalated appropriately.
Coordinates project and workstream leads without necessarily holding formal line-management responsibility.
Supports sponsors and governance forums in making timely, evidence-based decisions.
Does not ordinarily own the underlying business, product or technology functions.
Has no formal people-management responsibility unless separately assigned.

Skills And Experience

Strong programme-management experience across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience leading programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams or delivery teams.
Strong integrated-planning, governance and dependency-management capability.
Experience managing programme risks, resources, costs, forecasts and executive reporting.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Ability to identify critical dependencies, constraints and cross-project impacts.
Strong senior-stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing skills.
Ability to develop and present evidence-based options and recommendations.
Experience supporting governance forums and executive decision-making.
Working understanding of requirements, testing, controls, implementation and operational readiness.
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methods.
Experience in financial services or another regulated industry is desirable.
Exposure to artificial intelligence, automation, data, digital or emerging-technology programmes is desirable.
Specialist technical AI expertise is not required.

Programme or project-management qualification, such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or an Agile delivery certification, is advantageous.
Experience using programme-planning, reporting and delivery-management tools is advantageous.
Preferred qualification - Demonstrated experience establishing and scaling enterprise AI programs, including governance, operating model development, business activation, platform adoption, risk management, and measurable value realization across multiple business units."

Job Responsibilities And Requirements

Standard Security Life (SSL) is a leading provider of New York Disability Benefit Law (DBL) and statutory paid family leave (PFL) insurance. SSL is a division of Reliance Matrix and a member of the Tokio Marine Group.

The Senior Business Analyst for SSL will work internally and with external vendors to monitor, review and reconcile transactions between the Company’s policy administrative system(s), the general ledger and the bank accounts while ensuring overall data integrity of the Company’s premium, claim and commission transactions. This role will also support the evaluation, execution and expansion of automation, analytics and artificial intelligence tools that improve company processes, strengthen controls and enhance decision support.

The Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for the completion of data related regulatory filings to the Company’s regulator(s).

The Senior Business Analyst will also be involved in the design and implementation of future applications, training, change requests and problem reports. They will collaborate with IT and management in other departments (Claims, Underwriting, Financial, etc.) to determine the appropriate functionality and integration of while ensuring current and future business requirements are met.

In addition, the Senior Business Analyst will help identify practical AI and automation use cases across SSL Finance and related functions, assist in defining requirements and success measures, coordinate with business and technology partners, and support adoption through testing, training, documentation and ongoing monitoring.

Serves as the liaison to IT for all SSL Administrative system related issues.
Investigates user concerns identifies problems, makes recommendations for resolution and collaborates with IT to implement the fix/change.
Seeks user feedback related to system efficiency and functionality and requests system changes and enhancements, as appropriate.
Attends regular meetings with managers from Underwriting, Claims, IT, Financial, etc. to determine the priority of recommended changes/enhancements.

Project Manager - Job Description

The US spends $160 Billion per year on highways. Every new car model costs at least $1 Billion to develop. Yet cars spend only 5% of their time driving. Where do these cars spend the other 95%? PARKED!

LAZ Parking is one of the largest operators in the growing multi-billion-dollar US parking industry. Founded in 1981, LAZ operates hundreds of thousands of parking spaces from offices nationwide. When it comes to parking, we are the experts!

Most importantly, LAZ is a PEOPLE FIRST company with a mission to "create opportunities for our employees and value for our clients." If you're looking to join a growing company led by passionate people committed to being the best, contact us today!

The Spirit of the Position

The Project Management Office (PMO) supports projects across every department at LAZ, including Operations, Finance, Technology, HR, Client Services, and newly acquired or partner businesses. The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams, coordinates internal and external partners, and keeps projects moving toward organizational goals.

The PMO works as both a project lead and a consulting partner. Depending on the project, this role may run a project end to end or help a department plan and run their own work using PMO tools and resources. The right person for this role will be able to adapt to the needs of the business or project in an agile way, always identifying and executing to add value and support.

Principal Duties

Planning and delivery

Build short- and long-term project plans with clear milestones, owners, and deadlines
Track progress against the plan and keep timelines and quality on track
Adjust schedules, scope, and targets as business needs, priorities, or funding change
Coordinate go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing (UAT), data validation, training, pilot rollouts, and handoff to operational owners
Close out projects by confirming ownership transfer, documenting lessons learned, and capturing project outcomes

Team and partner leadership

Lead cross-departmental teams, making roles, responsibilities, and goals clear for everyone involved
Assign and track action items with owners across departments, vendors, and partners
Serve as the main point of contact when multiple teams or departments share a project so everyone stays aligned
Manage vendor and partner relationships through implementation, including kickoffs, recurring status calls, contract and timeline coordination, and follow-up on open items
Support the integration of acquired or partner businesses onto LAZ systems and processes
Lay out options and tradeoffs so sponsors and stakeholders can make timely decisions

Communication and reporting

Facilitate recurring project meetings and send timely recaps with decisions, action items, owners, and due dates
Keep stakeholders updated so the project stays aligned with their goals
Build and maintain Monday.com boards and dashboards, project reports, and all project communications
Contribute to portfolio-level reporting, including the monthly PMO Executive Summary

PMO intake and continuous improvement

Support the PMO intake and discovery process by helping requesters through intake, connecting them with the right teams, and helping build business cases
Contribute to PMO resources such as playbooks, SOPs, templates, SharePoint content, newsletters, and feedback surveys
Help departments plan and run their own projects using PMO tools and best practices

Education

Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience
PMP or CAPM certification preferred

Experience

5+ years of project management experience, ideally in a PMO or multi-department setting
Experience leading software or system implementations with outside vendors
Experience with business integrations, operational transitions, or process changes across multiple departments is a plus

Skills

Works independently and makes timely calls on day-to-day project matters
Leads cross-functional teams without direct authority, including resolving conflicts and negotiating effectively
Manages vendor and partner relationships, keeping outside teams accountable to timelines and deliverables
Prioritizes tasks, manages time, and handles multiple projects across different departments at once
Works comfortably with people at every level of the organization, from frontline teams to executives
Strong written communication, including clear meeting recaps, status updates, and executive summaries
Brings a sense of urgency and follow-through
Adapts quickly to changing project requirements and priorities
Supports change management and business readiness so new tools and processes actually get adopted
Familiar with project management and collaboration tools such as Monday.com, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Loop), Jira, Trello, Asana, or GitHub
Comfortable working through system integrations and implementations with IT, development teams, and vendors, and willing to learn technical concepts as needed
Translates between technical and non-technical stakeholders so everyone has a shared understanding of project requirements

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Power Delivery - Remote
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

The Senior Power Delivery Project Manager provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, and monitoring of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation initiatives, within a defined geographic region, utility client base, or technical discipline. Supports utility capital programs and Power Delivery portfolios by ensuring all responsibilities across the full project lifecycle—including proposal development, project planning and startup, engineering coordination, procurement, construction execution, schedule and cost control, reporting, and project closeout—are executed, documented, and audited in accordance with WSP project management standards, Power Delivery best practices, and client requirements. Provides practical leadership, process improvement, and innovative solutions to address schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management challenges within a dynamic, regulated, and evolving Power Delivery and energy infrastructure environment

This position will be based out of Richmond, VA with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location in the region. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide Power Delivery project management leadership for large‑scale and complex utility infrastructure projects, ensuring clear task ownership, schedule accountability, and delivery milestones across transmission, distribution, and substation scopes; prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, margins, KPIs, earned value, hours and expenses, monitor external risks and contingencies, and ensure contractual compliance and successful delivery of assigned Power Delivery project portfolios.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies for utility clients, internal leadership, engineering teams, contractors, and regulators, maintaining strong relationships and providing timely reporting on project status, risks, and performance. [
Provide guidance during pursuit, initiation, and project startup phases, supporting Go/No‑Go decisions, contract and commercial reviews, pricing strategies, delivery risk assessments, and mitigation planning for Power Delivery and utility capital projects
Participate in and support the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, client presentations, scope alignment discussions, and project execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.
Mentor and coach project managers, engineers, and support staff, supporting career development, performance improvement, and leadership growth within the Power Delivery organization.
Manage, evaluate, and provide performance leadership to assigned staff, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety expectations, and delivery standards
Ensure timely updates and governance compliance for project management systems and documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans
Facilitate and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to establish roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Coordinate with area managers, technical leads, and resource managers to address staffing, subcontracting, and specialty support needs in a timely manner across Power Delivery programs.
Maintain regular client communications, including monthly progress reporting, safety performance, major risks/issues, and scope or budget impacts, reinforcing WSP’s role as a trusted Power Delivery advisor.
Participate in and lead problem project and recovery reviews, conducting root‑cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and developing project recovery and mitigation plans
Ensure consistent project reporting and governance updates to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, proactively identifying emerging scope, schedule, cost, or risk issues.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, cash flow, and invoicing, coordinating with project accounting and finance teams to resolve issues and maintain financial health of Power Delivery projects.
Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [
Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards
Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, client commitments, project risks, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
12+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.
Highly proficient understanding of the project delivery lifecycle within the A/E/C and utility industries, including proposal development, project initiation, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, commissioning, and project closeout, with a strong background in Power Delivery project management
Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.
Advanced proficiency in critical thinking, risk‑based decision‑making, and problem‑solving, including performing project management assessments, schedule and cost evaluations, forecasting, and scenario analysis to optimize Power Delivery project outcomes.
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively, persuasively, and professionally with executive leadership, utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.
Demonstrated self‑leadership and accountability, with strong attention to detail, quality, multitasking, and adaptability in a fast‑paced Power Delivery and utility project environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while providing technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to mid‑level and senior project staff, with strict adherence to QA/QC, safety, and delivery standards.
Advanced proficiency in technical writing, project documentation, office automation, and project management software, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), scheduling tools, and Power Delivery PM platforms.
Strong experience managing the review, approval, and coordination of discipline‑specific deliverables, technical reports, scopes of work, and execution plans within a multi‑project, multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery portfolio.
Demonstrated ability to influence and gain cooperation from a broad range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, utility clients, subcontractors, consultants, and matrixed internal teams, without formal authority.
Proven commitment to workplace health, safety, and environmental performance, including adherence to WSP safety programs, drug/alcohol policies, and harassment‑free workplace standards.
Strong ability to adapt to changing project demands, including flexible schedules, outage‑driven work, and evolving client priorities common in Power Delivery and utility capital programs.
Willingness to support occasional travel to client sites, regional offices, and project locations as required to support Power Delivery project execution and client engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering or Masters of Business Administration (MBA)
Essential project management certification (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $170,000 - $245,000

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Life Sciences Program Executive

Brazil or Argentina | Remote

Job Description

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.

The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce.

Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact

AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.
Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.
Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. You earn trust through consistently accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.
The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.
The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.
Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.
Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.
White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce.

Minimum Requirements

Demonstrated experience applying AI productivity tools, automation, or agentic workflows within a professional services or program delivery context, with measurable impact on delivery efficiency or customer outcomes
12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes
Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes
5+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) sufficient to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities
5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, earned value analysis, and delivered-versus-bid margin
End-to-end knowledge of system development, implementation, and operational readiness within Life Sciences environments, including familiarity with regulated industry requirements
Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and outcomes
Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical, commercial, and regulatory audiences
Must be able to operate as a fully billable IC

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level, with the ability to credibly advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
Deep knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field engagement, HCP engagement, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls, and data-driven customer insights
Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or equivalent CRM platforms purpose-built for pharma and biotech
PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale
Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud); certifications are a requirement of the role and available through the global education reimbursement program
Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline
Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context, including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Additional Information

Travel approximately 25%, with variation based on customer need
Bachelor's degree required

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Title And Summary

Lead Technical Program Manager

Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

The Digital Solutions Engineering team is responsible for Mastercard’s electronic payment system as well as ensures payments are convenient and secure. The products are primarily focused on authentication, tokenization, fraud prevention, and risk mitigation across all payment channels as well as all stakeholders, issuers, acquirers, merchants, processors, and consumers. The key objectives of the solutions are to prove identity, reduce abandonments, reduce fraud, increase approval rates, and secure the payments ecosystem.

We are hiring a Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Authentication Solutions platform. The core Authentication Solutions (3DS and Passkey based) teams use a mix of technologies as we work to revolutionize our technology offerings.

Job Overview

Technical Program Managers at Mastercard collaborate to define the how and when of our strategic delivery goals. This role plays a pivotal role in driving complex, cross-functional projects and maintain alignment of our goals to organizational objectives. The responsibility of this teammate is to ensure technical solutions are delivered on time and meet the desired outcomes.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive progress, manage complex projects, and ensure optimal delivery. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in decision-making, problem decomposition, and effective communication, while maintaining a strong grasp of business context and technical details.

Accelerate project progress by making crisp, timely decisions and clearing blockers.
Navigate difficult situations to find viable paths forward and decompose problems into manageable units from ideation to execution.
Organize work for optimal delivery, negotiating priorities, facilitating progress, and raising issues to management as needed.

Secure shared understanding and buy-in for solutions, clearly describing their impact on Mastercard and its customers.
Use communication as a preventive control, ensuring meetings are effective, consensus is built, and decisions are well-documented.
Optimize approaches, demonstrate improvements using data, and drive continuous improvements through retrospectives, staff meetings, and status updates.
Proficiently manage scrum delivery, understand business context, customer use cases, and the functionality, architecture, and dependencies of involved systems.
Represent team services to stakeholders and external partners, bringing developers or SMEs to meetings as necessary.
Actively manage dependencies, influence vendors and partners, and ensure alignment with program goals.
Deliver independently while occasionally seeking direction from peers and managers.

All About You

Born simplifier.
Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong ability to make timely decisions and manage complex projects.
Proficiency in scrum delivery and a track record of optimizing processes and demonstrating improvements with data.
Deep understanding of business context, customer use cases, system functionality, and industry technologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead effective meetings, build consensus, and clearly articulate decisions.
Experience in managing dependencies, influencing external partners, and representing team services to stakeholders.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to serve as the technical subject-matter expert (SME) for the Trust and Assurance team. This role will be responsible for leading the technical side of the compliance automation function of the team. A core part of the role is analyzing controls within the GRC platform to ensure they are accurate, meet framework requirements, and pull the necessary evidence to prove effectiveness. You will also partner with engineering teams to embed compliance into their workflows from the start. Strong compliance framework knowledge, solid program-management skills, and experience with AI technology are essential.

What You Will Do

Serve as the team's technical authority.

Act as the technical SME and primary point of contact for the Trust and Assurance team: interpret how systems and controls work, guide technical decisions, and identify opportunities to make workflows and tooling more efficient.

Manage compliance stack.

Oversee control mapping, evidence collection, and monitoring workflows, and manage the integrations that connect the GRC platform to cloud platforms and internal systems.

Establish control monitoring. Translate technical controls into automated, continuous checks, expanding monitoring coverage across the compliance stack and replacing manual reviews with ongoing monitoring.
Reduce audit burden.

Ensure every control has an accountable owner, support gap assessments and the rollout of new frameworks, and keep controls in a continuously audit-ready state.

Embed compliance into engineering.

Partner with engineering teams to build compliance requirements into their workflows and processes from the start, so compliance is designed in rather than added later.

Drive delivery and keep stakeholders aligned.

Manage initiatives through to completion, and communicate compliance risk, control status, and program progress to technical and non-technical audiences through clear, actionable summaries.

What You Will Bring

4+ years in GRC, compliance, or a technical role supporting cybersecurity programs, including leading programs and guiding or mentoring others.
Strong program and project management skills, with a track record of delivering across multiple teams.
Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and/or FedRAMP) and hands-on audit experience.
Enough technical depth to be the team's technical point of contact: comfortable reasoning about cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, and data flows, and interpreting technical work with AI assistance, even if you do not write code.
Proven ability to lead technical discussions with engineers and subject-matter experts and ask the right questions to understand how controls and systems work.
Hands-on experience with a GRC or compliance-automation platform (e.g., LogicGate, ServiceNow, Drata), and comfort using AI tools in compliance workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate between compliance and engineering for both technical and leadership audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills:

Ability to write code or scripts (e.g., Python) to build automation directly.
Experience building AI/ML-powered or agentic applications, and with API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, or deploying production-grade services.
Technical background in systems administration, software engineering, cloud security, or security engineering.
Prior experience as a technical SME, or as a bridge between compliance and engineering teams.
Experience leading a SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or NIST 800-53 audit end-to-end, and familiarity with OSCAL or other compliance-automation tooling.
Familiarity with security monitoring tools (e.g., Tenable, Splunk), Git, and cloud infrastructure automation tooling (e.g., Terraform, Puppet, Jenkins).
Experience in SaaS, GovCloud, FinTech, or other highly regulated environments.
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CCSK, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
