Job Description:

The Material Program Management (MPM) Manager is the Supply Chain focal point responsible for leading the end-to-end material strategy and execution for assigned programs. This role partners closely with Program Management, Procurement, Planning, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance/Business Management, and other Supply Chain functions to ensure material requirements are aligned to program cost, schedule, production, and customer commitments.

The MPM Manager leads a team of Material Program Managers and is accountable for providing clear visibility to the program’s overall material position, including material availability, procurement status, shortages, supplier risks, forecast performance, inventory, and production readiness. The manager ensures risks are identified early, actions have clear ownership and closure plans, and material issues are escalated at the appropriate level before they impact program execution.

This position requires a leader who can operate strategically while maintaining strong discipline, translate complex material information into actionable program-level insights, and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution of material, cost, schedule, and supplier challenges.

Essential Functions:

Lead, develop, coach, and provide day-to-day direction to a team of Material Program Managers supporting assigned programs.
Own and drive the integrated material strategy for assigned programs, ensuring procurement, planning, inventory, supplier performance, quality, engineering, and production activities are aligned to program requirements and schedule.
Lead material readiness and Line of Balance (LOB) reviews to determine whether material supports planned production and delivery schedules. Identify constraints, gaps, and material at risk of not meeting program need dates.
Drive proactive identification and management of material risks and opportunities, ensuring each significant issue has a clearly defined program impact, root cause, mitigation/recovery plan, action owner, and required completion date.
Establish appropriate escalation paths for critical material and supplier issues and ensure risks are elevated based on potential impact to production, customer commitments, cost, and schedule.
Lead the material forecasting process for assigned programs, including development and validation of monthly and quarterly material forecasts, identification of major forecast drivers, risks and opportunities, and corrective actions necessary to improve forecast accuracy.
Analyze forecast performance and material actuals to identify significant variances, understand root causes, and implement corrective actions that improve predictability and financial performance.
Partner with Procurement and Supplier Management organizations to ensure critical supplier issues are actively managed and recovery plans support program requirements.
Support development and execution of program proposals, Estimates at Completion (EACs), material budgets, long-range material strategies, and other program financial planning activities.
Provide clear, concise executive-level communication regarding material status, significant risks and opportunities, forecast performance, supplier challenges, recovery actions, and decisions or support required from leadership.

Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 9 years of prior related management experience; or a Graduate Degree or equivalent with 7 years of prior related management experience; or a minimum of 13 years of prior related management experience in lieu of a degree.

Experience within aerospace, defense, or another complex engineered product/manufacturing environment.
Experience supporting development and/or production programs from early development through qualification, production ramp, and full-rate production.
Working knowledge of MRP/ERP systems, material requirements planning, production planning, procurement, inventory management, supplier management, and manufacturing operations.
Experience with material forecasting, EACs, program financial management, risk and opportunity management, and integrated program schedules.
Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, develop recovery strategies, and lead cross-functional teams through complex material and supplier issues.
Experience implementing process improvements, standard work, reporting automation, dashboards, or data-driven management tools.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar analytics and visualization tools is preferred.
Knowledge of government contracting and the defense acquisition environment, including applicable FAR/DFARS requirements, is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, operate effectively in a matrixed organization, manage competing priorities, and make timely decisions in a rapidly changing environment.
Strong leadership, coaching, communication, problem-solving, and executive presentation skills.
Ability and willingness to travel to company facilities, customers, and suppliers as business needs require.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

About The Department

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager

Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies
Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation
Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Technical Program Manager (Planning – Payments Domain)

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Mastercard Network & Digital Payment Services team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own planning and delivery execution across our product and platform portfolio. You will run the planning function for the organization — roadmap, forecast, budget, headcount, and delivery commitments — across multiple concurrent programs.

As Senior Technical Program Manager, you will work with product managers, tech leads, architects, and operations and engineering leaders to deliver complex programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, build execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, manage escalations, and balance business needs against delivery constraints.

This is a planning and execution role rather than a hands-on engineering one. Success depends on structure, judgment, and problem-solving: bringing clarity to ambiguous work, making the plan and its trade-offs visible, and keeping leadership and delivery teams aligned on the same picture of reality.

The ideal candidate brings an entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable operating in ambiguity, willing to build the mechanism that doesn't exist yet, and able to run several unrelated programs at once without dropping any of them. You will spend much of your time with senior leaders and partner teams you do not manage, so the ability to influence without authority and earn trust quickly is essential. Highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and a strong problem-solve

Role

Lead Program Delivery: Drive complex technical programs end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams, removing blockers, and delivering against committed outcomes.
Own Planning & Roadmaps: Translate strategy into prioritized roadmaps, delivery plans, milestones, and forecasts across multiple teams and initiatives.
Manage Budget & Resources: Partner with Finance and Engineering to manage budgets, headcount, capacity, vendor spend, and trade-offs across competing priorities.
Drive Program Health: Establish program metrics, manage risks and dependencies, track delivery performance, and provide clear executive-level reporting and recommendations.
Influence Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Finance to drive alignment and accountability without direct authority.
Solve Complex Problems: Bring structure to ambiguity, identify root causes, resolve delivery challenges, and proactively drive decisions and issues to closure.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Use data, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to improve program execution, delivery predictability, operational processes, and alignment with strategic objectives.

All About You

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Proven program leadership: Lead large-scale technical programs from inception through delivery, translating vision into measurable business outcomes.
Strategic planning & execution: Build road maps, manage priorities, and execute complex programs across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid environments.
Financial & resource management: Own program budgets, forecasts, headcount, capacity planning, and resource allocation across multiple teams.
Executive communication: Clearly communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to senior executives using concise, data-driven insights.
Cross-functional leadership: Influence without authority, align senior stakeholders and partner teams, and drive accountability across complex organizations.
Technical & analytical acumen: Apply strong problem-solving skills and technical fluency to assess complexity, identify delivery risks, and drive effective decisions.

Desirable / Additional Capabilities

Thrives in ambiguity: Creates structure, processes, and solutions where requirements or established practices are unclear.
Entrepreneurial mindset: Identifies opportunities, takes ownership, and drives improvements beyond defined responsibilities.
Global program coordination: Experience managing stakeholders, teams, and vendors across multiple locations and time zones.
Technology delivery expertise: Familiarity with software development lifecycles, release management, testing, and operational readiness.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

About Highwood

Highwood Emissions Management is the industry's independent partner on methane — combining the world's most widely deployed methane reporting platform with a consulting team that sits at the frontier of measurement science, regulatory development, and emissions strategy.

Our clients include producers accounting for over 10% of global oil and gas production. We have delivered more than 300 methane engagements across 50+ operators on six continents, and we maintain a 100% success rate on OGMP 2.0 Gold Standard submissions. When regulations change, we know first — because our team is writing the standards, advising regulators, and shaping industry practice from the inside.

We launched in 2020 with a mission to collaborate, innovate, and educate our way to a world with effective and affordable emissions management. That mission is more urgent than ever: methane is shifting from voluntary disclosure to commercial liability, and the operators who get this right early will have a durable competitive advantage. Our job is to make sure they do.

Working at Highwood is not easy — but it is meaningful, fast-moving, and genuinely consequential. If you want to work on one of the hardest and most important problems in energy transition, alongside people who are shaping how the world measures and manages methane, this is the place.

Highwood is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. We value diversity of experience, worldview, and perspective.
Your Mission 

The Senior Marketing Program Manager owns the planning, execution, and evolution of Highwood's core marketing programs across customer marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), corporate communications and public relations, and partner and community programs. You will turn Highwood's technical leadership into credible proof points, stronger market visibility, deeper customer engagement, and measurable pipeline impact. 
This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone that is looking to partner with a team that is passionate about building high-performing programs and is looking to work alongside industry experts looking to make eliminating methane achievable and provable. Highwood is looking for a driven marketing and communications lead who can build program frameworks, cross-functional operating systems, scalable processes, and lead execution to ensure programs launch, perform, and improve over time. 
Core Responsibilities 

Corporate Communications & Public Relations 

·       Own and execute Highwood's corporate communications and PR strategy, with a strong focus on media relations. 
·       Develop regulatory and market-update media programs that strengthen Highwood's position as a thought leader in emissions management. 
·       Draft and distribute press releases, media materials, and internal communications that reinforce brand positioning and support business priorities. 
·       Build and maintain relationships with key media contacts, analysts, and industry influencers, and support proactive reputation and crisis communications. 
ABM Program Management & Execution 

·       Define and operationalize Highwood's ABM program frameworks, including 1:Many campaigns. 
·       Design and execute regional ABM campaigns that reflect local market dynamics, customer needs, and Sales priorities. 
·       Establish campaign calendars, stakeholder cadences, success metrics, and reporting that connect engagement to pipeline influence and ROI. 
·       Use performance data to iterate programs and improve results across target accounts and geographies. 
Customer Marketing & Advocacy 

·       Develop and execute customer communications for major initiatives and product updates. 
·       Create customer-facing materials that support inside and outside Sales. 
·       Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success so customer insights inform marketing strategy and program development. 
·       Build and scale a structured customer advocacy program, including case studies, customer reference, and referral programs that turn customer success into credible proof points for Sales and Marketing. 
·       Establish a clear customer engagement framework and systematically capture and share customer feedback across the business. 
Partner & Community Programs 

·       Expand partnership opportunities and reach across strategic and community partners. 
·       Develop and manage co-marketing campaigns, joint events, and partner enablement materials. 
·       Integrate partner and community programs into the broader marketing calendar and measure their contribution to brand and pipeline goals. 
What Success Looks Like 

·       Highwood's presence in target media and industry publications increases, with coverage that is proactive, on-message, and aligned to business priorities. 
·       ABM programs are structured, measurable, aligned with Sales, and demonstrate engagement and pipeline contribution across priority accounts and regions. 
·       Customer advocacy becomes a repeatable program: customer achievements are consistently captured, reference programs are accessible to Sales, and customers stay engaged through ongoing communications and programs. 
·       Partner and community programs are clearly defined, consistently executed, and tied to measurable brand and pipeline outcomes. 
·       Cross-functional programs run with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, reporting, and continuous improvement. 
About You 

·       Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent practical experience. 
·       7-10+ years of experience in B2B marketing program or project management, with experience in emissions management within oil and gas, with experience in environmental technology preferred. 
·       Proven track record leading complex, multi-channel marketing programs from concept through execution, measurement, and iteration. 
·       Demonstrated experience in at least three of the following: customer advocacy, ABM/ABX, corporate communications/PR, customer marketing, or partner/channel marketing. 
·       Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to align Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and external partners. 
·       Experience building and managing program roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics. 
·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting press releases, media materials, and executive communications. 
·       Working knowledge of HubSpot, project management tools, and marketing analytics platforms. 

The Benefits

·       We offer similar benefits to our employees elsewhere in the world.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.

About The Department

Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.

About The Role

Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative.

As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.

The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager
Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence
Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration
Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting
Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale
Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards
Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs

Desirable Skills And Knowledge

8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement
Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment
BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience
Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability
Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery
Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives
Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output
Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity
Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally
Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies
Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation
Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. You will keep the control set mapped once so a single test produces evidence for every framework, maintain the GRC tool as the system of record, own Groq's IT policies and security training, and take on audit execution to mature the GRC function from reactive to proactive program.

Location:
This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area
. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

Responsibilities & Opportunities In This Role

Run the audit calendar across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and other frameworks; manage day-to-day auditor relationships, fieldwork logistics and evidence readiness.
Track audit findings through to closure with owners and dates so findings do not recur between cycles.
Maintain the control catalogue and framework mapping so one control test produces evidence for every framework it satisfies, and coordinate SME evidence requests so each control is evidenced once per period, not once per framework.
Maintain Vanta GRC as the system of record: integration coverage, automated evidence, test ownership and documentation within their review cycle.
Own the IT policy lifecycle (review cadence, approvals, acknowledgements) and the security awareness training program, with completion tracked as audit evidence; report audit status, open findings and evidence coverage to security leadership on a recurring basis.

Ideal Candidates Have/are

5+ years in compliance program management, including hands-on execution of at least two concurrent framework audits.
Experience mapping controls across frameworks and reducing duplicate evidence collection, and administering a GRC platform as a system of record.
Experience managing external auditors, drafting scope statements for executive review, and coordinating SMEs across stakeholders.
Experience owning a policy lifecycle and a security awareness training program, with completion evidence that has stood up in audit.
Experience at a Big 4 or equivalent audit firm delivering compliance engagements, so you know how auditors scope, sample and write findings.

Groq is seeking an Audit and Compliance Program Manager to run the audit program in multiple frameworks. You will keep the control set mapped once so a single test produces evidence for every framework, maintain the GRC tool as the system of record, own Groq's IT policies and security training, and take on audit execution to mature the GRC function from reactive to proactive program.

Location:
This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area

Run the audit calendar across SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and other frameworks; manage day-to-day auditor relationships, fieldwork logistics and evidence readiness.
Track audit findings through to closure with owners and dates so findings do not recur between cycles.
Maintain the control catalogue and framework mapping so one control test produces evidence for every framework it satisfies, and coordinate SME evidence requests so each control is evidenced once per period, not once per framework.
Maintain Vanta GRC as the system of record: integration coverage, automated evidence, test ownership and documentation within their review cycle.
Own the IT policy lifecycle (review cadence, approvals, acknowledgements) and the security awareness training program, with completion tracked as audit evidence; report audit status, open findings and evidence coverage to security leadership on a recurring basis.

5+ years in compliance program management, including hands-on execution of at least two concurrent framework audits.
Experience mapping controls across frameworks and reducing duplicate evidence collection, and administering a GRC platform as a system of record.
Experience managing external auditors, drafting scope statements for executive review, and coordinating SMEs across stakeholders.
Experience owning a policy lifecycle and a security awareness training program, with completion evidence that has stood up in audit.
Experience at a Big 4 or equivalent audit firm delivering compliance engagements, so you know how auditors scope, sample and write findings.

Project Manager – Energy

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE ENERGY TEAM

Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.

About The Role

We are seeking Construction Project Management professionals prepared to work as long-term travelers with per diem supplements if applicable. You will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of construction projects and the successful management of a high-performing team. You will manage the planning, execution, and financial performance of your projects using business practices that are consistent with our company values – people, safety, integrity, innovation, and excellence.

Job Responsibilities

Manage and lead projects and project teams successfully from qualification, through estimate, pre-construction, mobilization, execution, and closeout. Ensure all project and contractual agreements are met and performed safely and professionally within established budgets and timeframes.
Establish project execution plan and provide scheduling and coordination for each project. Collaborate with Superintendent and field team to ensure projects are completed on schedule.
Identify project risks and potential issues. Develop and execute recovery action plans.
Manage project financials, review and approve invoices, track budget variance, job cost, and productivity, and report on financial performance.
Successfully negotiate change orders.
Act as key point of contact with customers and end-user owners. Manage and develop customer and subcontractor relationships. Source and qualify new opportunities.
Develop and manage a high-performance team. Provide mentorship and training to employees to ensure growth and development.

About You

You possess dynamic leadership and management skills to influence and drive positive outcomes. You have thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking, and reporting methods necessary to profitably complete electrical construction projects. You have experience with union workforces, labor rate calculations, and collective bargaining agreements. In addition to your technical knowledge, you have a history of successfully leading teams and are passionate about developing and growing employees to their full potential.

Thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking, and reporting principles necessary to profitably complete electrical construction projects.
Experience with union workforces, labor rate calculations, and collective bargaining agreements preferred.
Verifiable experience of safe, reliable and integrity-driven work habits, including working in unsupervised field settings, and remote office locations when appropriate.
Strong management and leadership skills, to include a history of leading teams with a passion for developing employees.
Strong ability to influence and drive positive outcomes.
Highly proficient in MS Word, Excel, and Project. Experience with Accubid Classic preferred.

What You Will Gain

Upon joining the team at Cupertino Electric, you’ll be exposed to a new, diverse community of client, vendor and subcontractor partners. You will be empowered to build new relationships to enhance your future business development opportunities. As a Project Manager, you have an important responsibility of managing CEI’s projects in line with goals, financial parameters, and within the project timeline and specification with the purpose of optimizing revenue growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Armed with CEI’s top notch tools and copious internal resources, with the expertise you bring and a little elbow grease, you’re sure to be successful.

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.

Licensure/Certifications:
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent preferred.

Experience:
Three (3) years in renewable energy, PV preferred.

Driving Record:
Valid state-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

PLEASE NOTE:
CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. To learn more about "job scams" how to avoid them, click here.

CEI is a place where every single person can—and does—have an impact on the work we do and the communities we serve. Here, you can build your own story and grow to your full potential. You can collaborate and celebrate with amazing people. And you’ll go home every day knowing you helped contribute to important work that shapes people’s lives. Our commercial, data center and energy projects may be complex, but our approach is simple. We build great things and we do it with great people.

Intuit’s Mid-Market organization is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Generation Analyst to drive deep insights across the demand generation funnel. This role will be responsible for analyzing performance from first touch through lead routing and handoff, identifying leakage, uncovering trends, and ensuring every lead is properly tracked, routed, and acted upon. Responsibilities

Analyze the end-to-end demand generation funnel for Intuit’s Mid-Market business, from lead creation through routing, acceptance, and downstream outcomes.

About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.

Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .

Role Summary

As a Threat Analyst on our Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team, you will provide best-in-class monitoring, detection, and response services to proactively defend customer environments before attacks prevail. You will work alongside and contribute to a team of cyber threat hunters, incident response analysts, engineers, and ethical hackers by using enterprise, log analysis and endpoint collection systems to facilitate investigations, identification, and neutralization of cyber threats.

Identify and respond to cyber threats occurring within customer environments

Acknowledge and satisfy inbound customer requests and interact with customers through various mediums

Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills, with proven ability to think outside the box
Customer service-oriented with strong written and verbal communication skills

Passion for all things related to information technology and cybersecurity

Knowledge of Mitre ATT&CK framework
Knowledge of incident response procedures
Basic understanding of network traffic analysis including TCP/IP, routing, switching, protocols, etc.
Basic understanding of Windows event log analysis

Experience with SQL query construction
Experience with OSQuery
Experience with enterprise information security data management - SIEM experience
Programming and scripting skills - proficient knowledge of Powershell

A Security Analyst works as an individual contributor within Threat Response organization. This role is responsible for leading complex alert investigations, validating and responding to security incidents, and supporting real-time decision‑making during high‑severity events.

The analyst will gain a strong working knowledge of Edward Jones’ technology environment, security tooling, and operational processes, and applies that knowledge to quickly assess scope, impact, and appropriate response actions. This role may guide junior analysts, contribute to incident response execution, and ensure investigations are thoroughly documented and operationally sound.

What You Will Do

Investigate, validate, and triage security alerts to identify and respond to security incidents, escalating confirmed or high‑risk activity in accordance with Threat Response procedures.
Lead in‑depth analysis of host, network, log, file, and identity data to determine incident scope, root cause, and potential impact.
Coordinate with incident response partners and technical teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery actions during active security incidents.
Provide real‑time analytical input to Threat Response leadership during high‑severity or time‑sensitive incidents to support rapid decision‑making.
Ensure all investigations, actions, and outcomes are accurately documented in case management systems to meet operational, audit, and legal requirements.
Mentor and support junior Threat Response analysts by reviewing investigations, providing guidance on analysis techniques, and reinforcing consistent investigation standards.
Maintain a strong understanding of the Edward Jones environment, common attack patterns, and adversary techniques relevant to Threat Response operations.
Contribute to continuous Threat Response improvement by identifying gaps in alerting, investigation workflows, and response procedures based on incident experience.
Participate in incident after‑action reviews and exercises, providing operational insights and recommended improvements to Threat Response processes.
Maintain proficiency in SOC tooling, including SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, LogRhythm) and case management/orchestration tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Swimlane, XSOAR).

What Experience You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in information systems or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience
Minimum of 3 years Information Systems Security experience, or 5 years of Information Technology experience with a focus on security controls and processes
Experience performing routine host, vulnerability, network, file, and log analysis from a variety of sources and platforms to support the incident response, threat detection, and hunt lifecycles.
Experience properly document/track all security investigations and work to meet department, audit, and legal requirements.
Maintain knowledge and understanding of current security threats and vulnerabilities and of how threat actors execute common attack paths. Ensure timely and accurate collection of this threat intelligence data for analysis and reporting purposes.
Contribute to the team's processes and documentation by suggesting opportunities to incorporate industry best practices and lessons learned from previous events.
Participate in after-action reviews for security incidents and red team exercises.
Effectively communicate with peers and leadership to ensure awareness of progress and challenges.

The Ethics & Compliance Data Analyst supports the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the company's Ethics & Compliance (E&C) program through data-driven insights, advanced analytics, technology-enabled solutions, and reporting. This role leverages data to monitor program effectiveness, identify emerging risks and trends, support decision-making, and communicate the impact of E&C activities through clear, actionable visualizations and insights. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building trustworthy datasets, developing analytical solutions, and translating complex information into compelling business narratives.

Key Responsibilities

Program Operations: Support the E&C program lifecycle (risk assessment, policy management, training, communication, investigations, audits, analytics). Partner with Legal and other functions (i.e. HR, Internal Audit, Finance, etc.) and business leaders to embed compliance into operational processes.
Data, Analytics & Insights: Develop and maintain impactful dashboards, analytical products, and technology-enabled solutions using E&C data sources (e.g., hotline/case systems, training platforms, third-party risk, gifts and travel, conflicts of interest, investigations, and audit findings). Monitor key indicators such as allegation volume, cycle time, training completion, audit activity, OARs, and awareness campaigns. Transform complex data into clear visual stories that communicate risk hotspots, trends, root causes, and remediation efforts across geographies, business units, functions, and organizational structures. Establish data quality controls, coordinate data integrations and exports, automate recurring reporting processes, and maintain governance of key E&C data sources.
AI & Technology Enablement: Implement E&C-related AI and automation initiatives that improve data analysis, reporting, and visualization capabilities. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop and deploy AI-enabled tools, workflows, prompts, and templates that support E&C processes. Manage the E&C portfolio of AI use cases from intake and prioritization through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications that enhance data accessibility, reporting capabilities, and decision-making across the E&C function.
Stakeholder Engagement & Culture: Create executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate E&C performance, risks, trends, and key insights to targeted audiences. Track E&C engagement with leadership populations (i.e. DGMs, MDs, etc.), including proactive monitoring for stakeholder rotation. Provide data and trend analysis to support quarterly board-level reporting. Support campaigns that promote ethical culture by using data to target messaging and optimize channels. Train stakeholders on dashboard usage and data interpretation and enable self-service analytics where appropriate.

Integrity & discretion - Handle sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment and professionalism.
Analytical problem solving & innovation - Use data, analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to identify trends, uncover actionable insights, solve challenges, and improve E&C decision-making and program effectiveness.
Data storytelling - Transform complex data into clear, compelling visuals and narratives that inform and influence stakeholders.
Operational excellence - Organize workflows, meet deadlines, and document processes.

Tools & Technologies

Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel including Power Query and PivotTables); business intelligence and data visualization platforms; AI and automation tools; workflow technologies; data integration and reporting solutions.

Messung der Qualität und Genauigkeit von Bestandsvorgängen bei gleichzeitiger Rückmeldung an den Betrieb
Planung und Ermittlung der Ursachen von Bestandsabweichungen durch Ursachen-Wirkungs-Analyse

Entwicklung von Datenerfassungsprozessen und Datenmanagementsystemen

A day in the life

Du stellst sicher, dass wichtige Leistungskennzahlen täglich, wöchentlich oder monatlich überprüft werden.

Du führst detaillierte Analysen zu Verhaltensweisen und Prozessen durch, die sich auf die Bestandsintegrität auswirken.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Inbound, Outbound und Bestandskontrolle zusammen, um Tools zu entwickeln und Daten zu analysieren, die Verbesserungsinitiativen unterstützen.

Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.

In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

The Program Manager is responsible for leading the integrated delivery of complex programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.

The initial assignment will support a major strategic programme involving artificial intelligence, automation and emerging technologies. The role will establish the programme structure, roadmap, integrated plan and governance arrangements and provide clear oversight of outcomes, dependencies, risks, resources, costs and decisions.

This is a generalist Program Manager position. The successful candidate may subsequently lead other strategic, regulatory, product, data, digital and operational-change programmes as business priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Establish the programme structure, governance model and delivery cadence.
Translate strategic objectives into an integrated programme roadmap and plan.
Define:
programme outcomes and scope;
projects and workstreams;
milestones and delivery gates;
roles and accountabilities;
governance and decision forums;
escalation routes.

Coordinate business, product, technology, operations, risk and other stakeholders.
Manage programme-level:
scope and milestones;
dependencies and critical paths;
resources and capacity;
costs and forecasts;
risks, assumptions, issues and decisions;
actions and governance requirements.

Coordinate opportunity assessment, prioritisation and mobilisation.
Integrate requirements, solution delivery, controls, testing and operational readiness into the programme plan.
Coordinate pilot design, implementation, adoption and value-measurement activities.
Monitor progress against agreed outcomes, milestones and delivery gates.

Escalate material risks, resource gaps and unresolved decisions.

Use approved digital and AI-enabled tools to improve programme planning, analysis and reporting while retaining appropriate human accountability.

Leads a complex programme comprising multiple projects or interconnected workstreams.
Defines and maintains the programme-management approach, integrated plan and governance structure.
Operates with a high degree of autonomy within agreed strategic objectives.
Coordinates stakeholders across business, product, technology, operations and control functions.
Accountable for consolidated programme visibility, including outcomes, progress, dependencies, risks, resources and decisions.
Develops options and recommendations where material delivery trade-offs exist.
Ensures programme-level risks, dependencies and decisions are identified, owned and escalated appropriately.
Coordinates project and workstream leads without necessarily holding formal line-management responsibility.
Supports sponsors and governance forums in making timely, evidence-based decisions.
Does not ordinarily own the underlying business, product or technology functions.
Has no formal people-management responsibility unless separately assigned.

Skills And Experience

Strong programme-management experience across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience leading programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams or delivery teams.
Strong integrated-planning, governance and dependency-management capability.
Experience managing programme risks, resources, costs, forecasts and executive reporting.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Ability to identify critical dependencies, constraints and cross-project impacts.
Strong senior-stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing skills.
Ability to develop and present evidence-based options and recommendations.
Experience supporting governance forums and executive decision-making.
Working understanding of requirements, testing, controls, implementation and operational readiness.
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methods.

Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.
Programme or project-management qualification, such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or an Agile delivery certification, is advantageous.
Experience using programme-planning, reporting and delivery-management tools is advantageous.
Preferred qualification - Demonstrated experience establishing and scaling enterprise AI programs, including governance, operating model development, business activation, platform adoption, risk management, and measurable value realization across multiple business units."

$114,700 - 194,900 USD

Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Our Mission

Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a Great Place to Work
for the third
consecutive year
! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with passion
, thrives on positivity
, and delivers with precision
. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

The Opportunity:

The Business Intelligence Analyst will support the Strategy and Analytics team with the execution of detailed analysis and creation of reports, dashboards and visualizations that provide the business with critical information to make informed decisions. The individual will use various tools and techniques to identify trends, patterns, and insights, working with data from various sources, ensuring data quality and integrity, and collaborating with various groups and stakeholders across the business to understand information requirements as well as maintain data integrity/perform audits in our data platform.

Utilize business intelligence and reporting software, database tools, Microsoft Excel, and Office automation to design, build, assess, maintain, improve, and distribute dashboards and reports, combine data, and present accurate information.

Responsibilities

Distill complex data and relationships into clear, concise charts and visualizations, support ad hoc data requests and analysis.
Design data models to extract data from operational databases and transform the data to easily understood business views.

Process unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis- then do the analysis.
Automate manual processes.
Navigate CRM and other systems to build reporting, ensure consistency and compliance across the departments.
Develop management monthly KPI’s/reports and BI dashboards for stakeholders across all business functions: technology, operations, field, billing etc
Perform in-depth analysis to identify key business risks and opportunities and make recommendations to improve overall profitability

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Comp Sci/ MIS/ Data Analytics/ Math or Statistics (or any analytical/data driven discipline)
0-2 years of experience working within business intelligence (Co-op/Internships included)
High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL 
Strong SQL experience is a must with knowledge of relational databases, and ability to build and maintain views
Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
Data driven analytical skills, knowledge and/or experience related to financial analysis
Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges
Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing demands and deadlines, are essential
Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.
Excellent skills in Excel, R/Python, SQL
Experienced with BI Tools such as Power BI / Tableau / SAP (Power BI Preferred)
Creativity, relationship building skills and dedication are all highly desirable

Job Summary

The Data Governance Analyst plays a critical role in advancing enterprise data governance by partnering with business stakeholders, technology teams, and the data governance organization. This role requires exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear, actionable guidance.

The analyst will work cross-functionally with IT Teams to guide governance best practices, define data quality and metadata requirements, and convert business needs into technical deliverables. In addition to driving functional requirements, this role is responsible for executing technical development work—building, configuring, and deploying data governance solutions across the data catalog, metadata, and other data quality platforms.

The analyst will own the end-to-end delivery of governance capabilities, ensuring product integrity, enabling scalable processes, and championing data governance across diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & Documentation: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, define, validate, and document data requirements and specifications.
Strategy & Planning: Contribute to functional governance planning by aligning catalog structure, metadata standards, business glossaries, and quality rule frameworks to enterprise objectives.
Product Quality Assurance: Maintain and govern metadata assets, business glossary content, and quality rules to ensure accuracy, consistency, compliance, and ongoing reliability.
Product Quality Assurance: Conduct proactive monitoring and assurance of data integrity across the data catalog and quality rule configurations.
Execution & Delivery: Implement and enforce data quality rules in Atlan, and use Soda to support continuous quality monitoring.
Execution & Delivery: Support metadata integration and operational delivery in partnership with engineering, architecture, and data product functions.
Stakeholder Engagement & Lead: Facilitate frequent cross-functional collaboration with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and data product teams to promote governance alignment.
Stakeholder Engagement & Lead: Actively promote data governance best practices, standards, and catalog adoption within business units and enterprise forums.
Stakeholder Engagement & Lead: Serve as the designated Data Governance Subject Matter Expert (DG SME) in enterprise working sessions, representing business-unit needs and governance best practices.
Consult and Lead: Provide consultative expertise and facilitation when guiding business stakeholders through data governance workflows and decisions.
Leverage AI technology to evaluate and optimise governance processes.

5% Domestic

Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience In Computer Science, Data Science, Informaton Technology, Business Management, or related technical field. Advanced degrees a plus. Req
Master's or other advanced degree Pref

4-7 years Hands-on data governance experience supporting data cataloging, master data management (MDM), metadata governance, or data quality monitoring and remediation. Req
2-4 years Practical understanding of data privacy, regulatory compliance, data policy frameworks, or industry data protection standards. Pref
2-4 years Experience supporting the development, configuration, or management of data privacy policies, compliance requirements, or governance controls within data policy or catalog platforms. Pref
2-4 years Prior experience contributing to data privacy tooling or policy governance in platforms such as Atlan. Pref

Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with a talent for aligning diverse perspectives around a common vision.

Job Responsibilities And Requirements

Standard Security Life (SSL) is a leading provider of New York Disability Benefit Law (DBL) and statutory paid family leave (PFL) insurance. SSL is a division of Reliance Matrix and a member of the Tokio Marine Group.

The Senior Business Analyst for SSL will work internally and with external vendors to monitor, review and reconcile transactions between the Company’s policy administrative system(s), the general ledger and the bank accounts while ensuring overall data integrity of the Company’s premium, claim and commission transactions. This role will also support the evaluation, execution and expansion of automation, analytics and artificial intelligence tools that improve company processes, strengthen controls and enhance decision support.

The Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for the completion of data related regulatory filings to the Company’s regulator(s).

The Senior Business Analyst will also be involved in the design and implementation of future applications, training, change requests and problem reports. They will collaborate with IT and management in other departments (Claims, Underwriting, Financial, etc.) to determine the appropriate functionality and integration of while ensuring current and future business requirements are met.

In addition, the Senior Business Analyst will help identify practical AI and automation use cases across SSL Finance and related functions, assist in defining requirements and success measures, coordinate with business and technology partners, and support adoption through testing, training, documentation and ongoing monitoring.

Duties And Responsibilities

Serves as the liaison to IT for all SSL Administrative system related issues.
Investigates user concerns identifies problems, makes recommendations for resolution and collaborates with IT to implement the fix/change.
Seeks user feedback related to system efficiency and functionality and requests system changes and enhancements, as appropriate.
Attends regular meetings with managers from Underwriting, Claims, IT, Financial, etc. to determine the priority of recommended changes/enhancements.
Chairs System meetings as necessary to provide feedback to the SSL Management Team regarding system performance, development and status.

Regularly meets with managers to discuss new procedures, system enhancements, etc.

Maintains consistent company process and regulatory compliance through appropriate staff communication and training.

Supports data readiness activities for AI-enabled solutions, including source-system analysis, data mapping, exception identification, validation routines and documentation of data limitations or control considerations.

Completes regulatory data filings with regulatory authorities as required.

Completes special projects as assigned by management.
Assumes additional responsibilities as needed.

Experience with process improvement, data analysis, reporting, workflow automation or AI-enabled business tools preferred.

Proven ability to work well in a high visibility, public oriented environment, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proven ability to effectively participate in sales presentations and customer meetings.
Proven ability to work with the following equipment: personal computer programs (e-mail, Microsoft Word and Excel, etc.). Ability to use any or all of this equipment to track, measure and improve performance.
